activity.notes: Abu'l-Futuh Yusuf ibn Abdallah al-Kalbi governed Muslim Sicily from 990 until illness forced the transfer of effective authority in 998. ATLAS uses the Sicilian emirate as the immediate polity while noting the Kalbids' Fatimid-viceroyal context.

sources.title: The Kalbids of Sicily: Stalwarts of Fatimid Ifriqiya
sources.citation_text: Modern scholarship describes the Kalbids as the governing dynasty of Muslim Sicily and as Fatimid viceroys.

sources.title: Kalbids
sources.citation_text: The standard dynastic chronology lists Abu'l-Futuh Yusuf ibn Abdallah al-Kalbi as ruler from 990 to 998.
